macros.name: act
macros.doc: If you are numbering acts, use \act before each act to place act headers.

macros.name: addcharacter
macros.doc: Use \addcharacter to add characters to the cast page.

macros.name: address
macros.doc: \address blocks your address on the lower left of the title page.

macros.name: dialog
macros.doc: \dialog sets off speeches with the appropriate formatting.

macros.name: introduce
macros.doc: This command sets the character’s name in smallcaps when they are first introduced in stage directions.

macros.name: pause
macros.doc: Provided for convenience, this inserts a (Pause) stage direction for those of us who overuse them.

macros.name: scene
macros.doc: If you are numbering scenes, use \scene before each scene to place scene headers.

envs.name: castpage
envs.doc: To create a page for your cast of characters, use the castpage environment.
